title: Coastal temperatures during the 2014-2016 northeast Pacific heatwave
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 daily near-surface temperature for 1993-2020 off the US West Coast (30-48 N, 130-116 W), test the following findings of Gentemann et al. (2017, Geophysical Research Letters, doi:10.1002/2016GL071039) on the 2014-2016 northeast Pacific marine heatwave: (1) from January 2014 to August 2016 coastal sea surface temperatures were significantly warmer than usual, with a maximum anomaly of 6.2 C off Southern California; (2) nearshore anomalies persisted along the entire coast and abated only seasonally, during the spring upwelling season; (3) the coastal heatwave weakened in July 2016 and disappeared by September 2016. State your anomaly baseline and the nearshore band you use, give a verdict for each finding (reproduced, partly reproduced, not reproduced, or not testable with the supplied data) with quantitative evidence, and explain differences from the paper, which used satellite SST.

paper.title: Satellite sea surface temperatures along the West Coast of the United States during the 2014–2016 northeast Pacific marine heat wave
